div.head: Af 43
div.ab: {XXXVIII[I]} Eallum frioum monnum ðas dagas sien forgifene, butan þeowum monnum ⁊ esnewyrhtan: XII dagas on gehhol ⁊ ðone dæg þe Crist ðone deofol oferswiðde 7 sanctus Gregorius gemynddæg ⁊ VII dagas to eastron ⁊ VII ofer ⁊ an dæg æt sancte Petres tide ⁊ sancte Paulus ⁊ on hærfeste ða fullan wican ǽr sancta Marian mæssan ⁊ æt eallra haligra weorðunge anne dæg; ⁊ IIII Wodnesdagas on IIII ymbrenwicum ðeowum monnum eallum sien forgifen, þam þe him leofost sie to sellanne æghwæt ðæs ðe him ænig mon for Godes noman geselle oððe hie on ænegum hiora hwilsticcum geearnian mægen.

To all free men these days are given [off from work] except for slaves and esnas: twelve days at Christmas, and the day that Christ overcame the devil, and the commemoration day of St Gregory, and seven days before Easter and seven after, and one day at the feastday of St. Peter and St. Paul, and in the harvest the full week before St. Mary’s mass, and at the honoring of All Saints one day. And four Wednesdays on the four weeks in which Ember days fall shall be given to all slaves, so that they can give to whoever is most dear to them a portion of whatever any man gives them in God’s name or that they may earn in their fragments of time [in which they work on their own].

The following days shall be granted [as holidays] to all free men, though not to slaves and hired labourers: twelve days at Christmas and the day on which Christ overcame the devil; the anniversary of St. Gregory; seven days before Easter and seven days after; one day at the festival of St. Peter and St. Paul; and in autumn, the full week before St. Mary's mass; and one day at the celebration of All Saints. The four Wednesdays in the four Ember weeks shall be granted [as holidays] to all slaves whose chief desire is to sell anything which has been given to them in God's name, or which they are able to acquire by their labour in any portion of time at their disposal.

XXXVIIII. Eallum freomonnum ðas dagas sien forgifene, buton ðeowum monnum ⁊ esnewyrhtum: XII dagas on gehhol ⁊ ðone dæg þe Crist oferswiðde ðone deofol 7 scs. Gregorius gemynddæg ⁊ seofon dagas to eastrum ond VII ofer and an dæg to sc̄e Petres tide ⁊ sc̄e Paulus ⁊ on hærfeste ða fullan wican ǽr sc̄a Marian mæssan ⁊ æt Ealra haligra weorðunge ænne dæg; ⁊ IIII Wodnesdagas on IIII ymbrenwicum ðeowum monnum eallum syn forgifen ðam ðe him leofost sy to syllanne æghwæt ðæs þe him ænig mon for Godes nomon gesylle oððe heo on ænigum hiora hwilsticcum geearnian mægen.
